profile.summary:
👋 I've Got Gifts For You 🙂

Engineering & management skills bundled with a few years of experience in software development and risk auditing, wrapped with layers of results-oriented and process orchestration durable material, and a little note about the all-in-one (read the room) personality. 

Email or send me a direct message to check your eligibility!

Don't wait! Reach out Today or while supply lasts! 

~On a serious note, I'm Open To Work ! 
'Cloud' 'Software' 'Data' 'Engineer'

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed RESTful endpoints and contributed clean reusable code to a multi-module maven project, leveraging JUnit for testing and GitLab to manage the execution of the SDLC pipelines.

● Designed and documented a user-friendly Command-Line Interface for managing the automation and orchestration of microservices using Java 17 and Spring Frameworks, including Spring 6 and Spring Boot 3.

● Completed an intensive training program on Architecting on AWS, earning a certificate of completion and demonstrating proficiency in designing and deploying scalable, high available, and fault-tolerant systems on the AWS platform.

● Deployed instances of business processes modeled using an open source BPMN modeler for automating task execution.

● Mentored RTC students and engineering analysts through a 12-weeks technical project as a Women in Engineering coach.
